channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: Blithe Spirit: Theatre 98 (MON 10/26)
item.description: Weekends 10/16-11/1/2026 · eves + matinees | Theatre 98, Fairhope | from $20. Noël Coward's classic ghost-comedy plays at Fairhope's intimate community playhouse, a witty, dressed-up date in Fairhope.

item.title: Delta Reign Pre-Release at Trinity Games (MON 10/26)
item.description: Sunday 10/25 and Sunday 11/1 · start time not posted | Trinity Games | from $30. Trinity Games runs two Pokémon TCG Mega Evolution Delta Reign pre-release tournaments, on Sunday, October 25 and Sunday, November 1. Entry is $30 and includes a ready-to-play 40-card deck, four booster packs, a stamped promo card and a digital code card. Play is Swiss with random pairings. On 10/21 the shop's page showed the October 25 date sold out and November 1 still on sale.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (MON 10/26)
item.description: During library hours through 11/1 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. It hangs all day during the library's own hours through November 1, so call the library to confirm them before you go.

item.title: Pensacola Interstate Fair (MON 10/26)
item.description: Oct 22 – Nov 1 | Pensacola Interstate Fairgrounds | No published price. Eleven days of rides, livestock barns and fried everything at the fairgrounds off Mobile Highway. The 60% off Super Saver closed on 07/15/2026, and the fair has not posted what replaces it.

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (MON 10/26)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center (MON 10/26)
item.description: Oct 17 to Oct 30 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions from October through April. The first sessions in this window run Saturday 10/17 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/18 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Saturday 10/24 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/25 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Friday 10/30 at 9:30 PM. Capacity is limited for each session, so buy tickets early.

item.title: Pumpkin Decorating Contest at Niceville Library (MON 10/26)
item.description: Entries through Saturday 10/17 · voting Monday 10/19 to Saturday 10/24 · winners Tuesday 10/27 | Niceville Library | No published price. Niceville Library runs a pumpkin decorating contest for ages 13 and older. Entrants drop off a decorated pumpkin with a completed entry form during library hours through Saturday, October 17, and visitors vote for a favorite from October 19 to 24. The top three pumpkins win prizes announced on October 27, and entrants collect their pumpkins by 2:00 PM on October 31.

item.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street (MON 10/26)
item.description: Fri 10/23 to Sun 11/1 · Fri and Sat 7:30 PM, Sun 2:30 PM | Pensacola State College, Ashmore Auditorium, Building 8 | No published price. Pensacola State College stages Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street in Ashmore Auditorium over two weekends, October 23 to 25 and October 30 to November 1. The college describes the eight-time Tony Award winning musical as a thriller about an exiled barber who seeks revenge on a corrupt system of justice. One performance falls on Halloween night.

item.title: The Selma Boys: Book Cellar Music (MON 10/26)
item.description: Monday 10/26 · evening set, time printed as 5:30 to 7:30 | Page & Palette / Book Cellar | No published price. The Selma Boys play the Book Cellar at Page & Palette in Fairhope on Monday, October 26. The store's calendar lists a four piece lineup of regulars and says the group is rolling back onto the stage for another Monday night.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (MON 10/26)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (MON 10/26)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: The Next BIG Thing 2026 business conference (MON 10/26)
item.description: Monday 10/26 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Walton Area Chamber of Commerce | from $200. The Walton Area Chamber of Commerce runs a one-day business conference with national keynote speakers, breakout sessions, networking and a closing cocktail reception. Tickets are $200 for chamber members and $250 for everyone else. It is a professional event for adults.

item.title: Cornhole Open Play (MON 10/26)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members toss bags at the boards during open-play cornhole at the Niceville Senior Center. It runs casually throughout the center's regular weekday hours. City of Niceville residents play free, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Exercise Room (MON 10/26)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. The Niceville Senior Center's exercise room stays open for members to work through strength, cardio, and flexibility routines on their own schedule. Equipment includes two recumbent bikes, a treadmill, free weights, a stability ball, mats, and stretch bands. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Putting Green Open Play (MON 10/26)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members check out putters and balls at the front desk to practice on the Niceville Senior Center's putting green. It is casual, and you can work on your short game alone or play a round with friends. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Table Tennis Open Play (MON 10/26)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Niceville Senior Center's table tennis room is open for casual, drop-in play with no experience required. The city describes it as an active, social way to spend the morning rather than a competitive league. It shares the Tuesday 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM window with several other open-play programs at the center, and members age 55 and up are the intended audience.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (MON 10/26)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Preschool Playground Open Play: Hillcrest (MON 10/26)
item.description: Last Monday of the month · 9:00 AM-11:00 AM | Hillcrest Church Preschool | No published price. The preschool opens its playground to the public for two hours on the last Monday of every month. It moves at a toddler's speed exactly, with toddler-scale equipment, shade, and other little ones, and none of the drive that a real park day costs.

item.title: Ping Pong Meet-Up (MON 10/26)
item.description: 9:30 AM to 11:00 AM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. This ping pong meetup at the Niceville Senior Center is open to beginners and experienced players alike, and the city says no experience is required to join in. It runs Wednesday mid morning and repeats on multiple weekdays.

item.title: Destin Fishing Rodeo: Daily Public Weigh-Ins (MON 10/26)
item.description: Daily, Oct 1 – Oct 31 · 10:00 AM-7:00 PM | Docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar | Free. Anglers competing in the month-long Destin Fishing Rodeo bring their catches to the scale on the harbor docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar every day in October. The public is welcome to watch for free from 10 AM to 7 PM, and the crowd tends to grow with the size of the fish coming off the boats.

item.title: Gateway: From Graffiti to Gallery at the Mobile Museum of Art (MON 10/26)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, through 9/1/2027 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. The Mobile Museum of Art traces how artists who started with graffiti in New York's subways moved into galleries, with work by Basquiat, Haring, Scharf, KAWS and Banksy from the Masterworks Foundation collection. The show runs a full year, Tuesday through Saturday. Mobile County residents get in free on Thursdays.

item.title: Haunted Courtyard at Baytowne Wharf (MON 10/26)
item.description: Daily through Saturday 10/31 · 10:00 AM to 9:30 PM | Village of Baytowne Wharf, Tupelo Courtyard | Free. The Village of Baytowne Wharf turns Tupelo Courtyard into a haunted walk-through for the month of October. It is free to enter and open from 10 AM to 9:30 PM, so it fits a daytime stroll with small kids or a dusk visit before dinner. The courtyard sits between Cloak and Dagger and Paradise Found, beside Bunkley's.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (MON 10/26)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free.

item.title: Mexican Train Dominoes (MON 10/26)
item.description: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Mexican Train Dominoes at the Niceville Senior Center is pitched as easy to learn, welcoming first-time players alongside the regulars. It runs Wednesday late morning into early afternoon and repeats on multiple weekdays.

item.title: Adult Pickleball Program (17+), Destin Community Center (MON 10/26)
item.description: Mondays 10/12 through 10/26 · 10:30 AM-12:30 PM | Destin Community Center | from $5. The Adult Pickleball Program is a City of Destin pickleball session for ages 17 and up at Destin Community Center. It meets Mondays, October 12, 19 and 26, from 10:30 AM to 12:30 PM. The cost is $5 for residents and $10 for non-residents.

item.title: STEAM: Midnight Kitty Painting (Pensacola Library) (MON 10/26)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 to Saturday 10/31 · 11:00 AM | Pensacola Library | No published price. STEAM: Midnight Kitty Painting is a step-by-step painting class at Pensacola Library, 239 N. Spring St., where you paint a little shadow kitty watching the moon. It is recommended for ages 10 and up. A themed painting class is held almost every Saturday through Oct 31 at 11 AM.

item.title: Hearts Card Game (MON 10/26)
item.description: 1:00 PM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. The Niceville Senior Center opens its doors on Wednesday afternoons for a drop in game of Hearts, welcoming beginners and experienced players alike. No reservation is needed, so you can just show up and find a table. The center is open to members age 55 and up, and City of Niceville residents get free membership. Non-resident membership pricing isn't published, so call ahead.

item.title: Chess Club at West (MON 10/26)
item.description: Mondays · 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts an all ages chess club for beginners and experienced players. The library says the group meets every Monday afternoon at this location, so it is easy to build into a routine.

item.title: Crochet & Knit at Moorer (MON 10/26)
item.description: Mondays · 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. Adults bring their own knitting or crochet projects to work alongside other yarn crafters at the Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library. Beginners are welcome alongside experienced crafters, and it is as much about the company as the stitching.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach: paint nights and all-ages sessions (weekly programme) (MON 10/26)
item.description: Classes most weeks: Sunday 3 PM, Monday evenings, Saturday all-ages open studio | Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach | from $27. Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach is an artist-led canvas painting studio at 255 Miracle Strip Pkwy SE, Suite B-8, in the Publix shopping center in downtown Fort Walton Beach. October has an all-ages open studio, Halloween sessions, a book-lovers paint night and blacklight painting. Standard canvases cost $37-$39, all-ages sessions $27-$60 and Paint Your Pet $57-$59, and the studio is BYOB-friendly.

item.title: Youth Chess Club at the Crestview Library (MON 10/26)
item.description: Mondays · 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM | Crestview Library | No published price. The Crestview Library runs a Youth Chess Club every Monday afternoon for school-age players. The club is built to teach new players the game and to help experienced players improve.

item.title: Chess Club at Saraland (MON 10/26)
item.description: Mondays · 3:30 PM to 5:30 PM | Saraland Public Library | No published price. Chess players of all ages and skill levels gather at the Saraland Public Library to learn fundamentals or sharpen their strategy. It is a welcoming group for total beginners as well as experienced players.

item.title: Fall Festival at the Valparaiso Library (MON 10/26)
item.description: Monday 10/26 · 3:30 PM to 5:30 PM | Valparaiso Library | No published price. Valparaiso Library's annual Fall Festival fills a Monday afternoon with games, a cakewalk and more, and children are welcome to come in costume. A storybook-themed pumpkin decorating contest has an adult category and a kids category, with entries dropped off when the festival starts. Each pumpkin is photographed and voted on until 9:00 AM on October 29.

item.title: Bad Art Night: Self-Portraits (Brownsville Library) (MON 10/26)
item.description: Monday 10/26 · 5:00 PM | Brownsville Library | No published price. Bad Art Night: Self-Portraits is an informal art night at Brownsville Library, 3300 W. De Soto Street. No artistic skill is needed, and the library actively discourages it. It starts at 5 PM on Monday, Oct 26.

item.title: City of Destin's 26th Annual Fall Festival (MON 10/26)
item.description: Monday 10/26 · 5-8 PM | Destin Community Center | No published price. The city's long-running fall festival returns to the Community Center. The calendar listing gives date, time and venue only, with no activity list posted yet.

item.title: TBS Comics Fort Walton Beach weekly game nights (Yu-Gi-Oh, D&D, Magic, Lorcana, One Piece and more) (MON 10/26)
item.description: Game nights Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday · from 5 PM | TBS Comics Fort Walton Beach | No published price. TBS Comics Fort Walton Beach hosts weekly game nights at its shop on Mary Esther Blvd. Monday is Yu-Gi-Oh at 6 PM, and Tuesday is D&D Adventurers League at 5 PM. Wednesday has casual Magic all day and Digimon at 6 PM, and Friday has Magic Commander at 6 PM and Yu-Gi-Oh at 7 PM.

item.title: TBS Comics Pensacola weekly game nights (Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh, Lorcana, One Piece, D&D and more) (MON 10/26)
item.description: Game nights Monday, Wednesday and Thursday · from 5 PM | TBS Comics Pensacola | No published price. TBS Comics Pensacola hosts weekly game nights at its shop on North 9th Ave. Monday is Magic Commander at 6:30 PM. Wednesday has Marvel Crisis Protocol at 5 PM, Board Game Night at 6 PM, and D&D Adventurers League, Riftbound and Star Wars Unlimited at 6:30 PM. Thursday has Yu-Gi-Oh and Gundam TCG at 6:30 PM and Magic Modern at 7 PM, and Friday has Star Wars Unlimited, Digimon and Magic Commander at 7 PM.

item.title: Dwarf Jade Bonsai Workshop at The Gab Spot (MON 10/26)
item.description: Monday 10/26 · 6:00 PM | The Gab Spot | from $85. The Dwarf Jade Bonsai Workshop at The Gab Spot is a two-hour hands-on class by Zen Den Bonsai in Fort Walton Beach, on Monday, October 26 from 6-8 PM. Each person works on their own tree and goes home with a Japanese ceramic pot and an aftercare kit that has a tote, care sheet, shears, spray bottle and fertilizer.

item.title: Finn's Flashlight Fling at Steve's Farm Adventure Zone (MON 10/26)
item.description: Fridays 10/23 and 10/30 · 6:00 PM start listed for 10/23 | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm: Adventure Zone | from $20.44. Finn's Flashlight Fling is a two night event at the Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm in Walnut Hill on October 23 and October 30. Guests get lost in the corn maze with only a flashlight to guide them. The farm's page lists the first night at 6:00 PM.

item.title: Fractal-Burned Drinkware Workshop at Coastal Makers (MON 10/26)
item.description: Monday 10/26 · 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM | Coastal Makers | from $50. A two-hour class at Coastal Makers where guests burn a Lichtenberg fractal pattern into their own drinkware to take home, priced per person. Materials, instruction and the heated tool are included in the price.
